provenance.prompt: Generate ONE production game asset inspired by the approved plains gameplay reference: a single isolated side-on rectangular grass-and-stone platform block, about 4:1 width-to-height, occupying most of canvas with modest transparent margin. Thin readable straight horizontal grass top with restrained little tufts, warm muted olive green sunlit tips; natural cold-grey rough stone and compact dark earth side, cracks and painterly texture, largely rectangular silhouette, complete left and right end caps. Strong hand-painted natural texture and soft light like reference stone ledges. Exactly side-on orthographic, no perspective top surface. No ruins, characters, UI, weapon, flowers, scenery, cast shadow, background or text. Transparent background. Complete individual platform sprite, not a spritesheet or collage.
